lines.text: Zion says the LORD has forgotten her, but He says He will not forget her, even if a mother could.
The LORD has inscribed Zion on the palms of His hands, and her priests hasten back as destroyers depart.
Zion will wear the gathering crowd as jewelry, like a bride, and her land will be too small.
The nations will carry her sons in their arms, and judges will be her foster fathers.
The LORD will retrieve the captives of the mighty, save Zion's children, and be known as her Savior and Redeemer.
